description: Communauté d'Agglomération du Grand Dax : Voirie communale et communautaire is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Location, description, status of all the roads of the community based on the uncadastrated domain of the department of Landes. The division into surface sections is carried out according to the status of the track. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Greater Dax Agglomeration Community: Municipal and community roads" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inspire. The listing shows 2009-07-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
